why_trail.why: Guard sites read in source. The design lands as: dispatch stops calling _trip_hard_gate on advance and calls it on start+reopen instead; a new _trip_hard_band_active predicate feeds a require_why flag into advance so that at/over hard why_exempt is suspended and --mechanical is refused, keeping advance's return values unchanged; _trip_advisory's HARD branch and _refresh_attach_hint are rewritten. Baseline 1793/2/683 confirmed; selector exits 5 today.

(a)+(b) landed. dispatch now guards TRIP_HARD_GUARDED_VERBS = {start, reopen} and no longer guards advance; _trip_hard_gate keeps #190's identity check verbatim and delegates the band decision to a new _trip_hard_band_reading so the m2 no-silent-close rule cannot disagree about what 'at hard' means. 12 selector tests green; 4 existing Trip tests re-aimed from advance to start, none deleted; engine+gauge suites 406 passed.

(c) landed. advance gains require_why (default False, so direct callers are byte-identical); dispatch computes it from _trip_hard_band_reading at the CLI boundary. At/over hard --mechanical and silence are both refused by one exact message naming 'advance <id> --why', why_exempt is suspended AND the why is actually appended to the why_trail, and the postcondition refusal still precedes the why demand. 20 selector tests green; one more existing test re-aimed (test_hard_passes_once_refresh_request_exists -> a refresh-request does not buy silence); engine+gauge 411 passed.

(d) landed. The HARD advisory now states a changed instruction -- close THIS gate carrying your handoff, request a refresh, stop -- with no BLOCKED/unsafe/runaway/lost wording, asserted by full-string equality in both the pending-request and no-request branches. _refresh_attach_hint gained an optional why_id and emits the concrete live why-record id at both the advisory and the begin-work refusal, falling back to <why-id> only when no live understanding exists. 25 selector tests green; one more existing test re-aimed (test_hard_advisory_on_current_points_at_attach dropped its BLOCKED assertion, gained the instruction + <why-id>-fallback pins); engine+gauge 416 passed.
